WebViewJsInjectKeys.Window: Global Window, which can dispatch the exit event of the window
WebViewJsInjectKeys.WindowUtils: You can call to force close the window
WebViewJsInjectKeys.webViewJs: js calls the object of webviewjs that executes java script

RhinoInjectNames.dispatcher: EventDispatcher for internal use by scripts
RhinoInjectNames.javaRunner: Currently pointing to RhinoRunner, which is the host of the executed script.
RhinoInjectNames.a11yProxy: Accessibility shell (obsolete, more restrictive than convenient)
RhinoInjectNames.WebViewJsDispatcher: WebView JS dispatcher can be used to dispatch events globally. HTML loaded in all domains can receive the events dispatched by it.
